mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and labor market
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the periods following a sustained increase in GDPC1.
